description: 1-day release-age soak for my own packages (actions, reusable workflows, spoons, go-tools). The 7-day third-party soak guards against supply-chain risk; my own releases are frequent enough that it keeps restarting, so a pending update never matures (copier updates from go-tools sat on old template versions). A preset can't carry match* options: extend this from a packageRule that matches the first-party packages.
